summary: The proposed patch addresses a specific edge case in the migration optimizer but lacks documentation and may introduce complexity.

issues.description: The patch does not address all possible scenarios where multiple `AlterField` operations can be combined. It only handles the case where the previous operation is also an `AlterField`, which might miss other valid combinations.
The patch introduces a tuple `(AlterField, RemoveField)` instead of using `isinstance()` with a tuple, which could be considered a style nit.
